# Lore
> Lore is an AI teammate that lives in a team group chat conversation. It uses permitted team context, remembers decisions, performs bounded work, and reports results back in the conversation.

## Core pages
- https://www.loregroupchat.com/
- https://www.loregroupchat.com/ai-agent-for-slack/
- https://www.loregroupchat.com/ai-teammate-for-slack/
- https://www.loregroupchat.com/slack-memory/
- https://www.loregroupchat.com/for-startup-teams/
- https://www.loregroupchat.com/docs/how-lore-works/

## Product facts
- Lore works from the context of a team group chat.
- Lore can perform bounded research, browser work, documents, checklists, and follow-ups when the required tools are connected and permitted.
- Lore uses approval gates for external sends, posts, bookings, purchases, and other actions that represent a team or spend money.
- Lore handles one mission at a time. Integrations and availability can change.
